input.question: Self-review, both questions at once: (a) does the code implement the requirement correctly and completely, and (b) is the code itself correct and compliant with the project rules? Answer both parts.

target.rationale: No seeded defect is relevant to this question; any finding is a false positive unless the operator confirms it.

source.note: hand-made: seeded diff written against the real code of the named file(s); see draft_reference
